1. Write via sf_artifact_write(work_item_id="WI-0001", file_type="evidence_manifest", content=<JSON string>) a manifest with exactly 22 entries, EV-0001..EV-0022, ordered: TASK-WI-0001-001 unit idx0-4; TASK-WI-0001-002 unit idx0-3; TASK-WI-0001-003 unit idx0-3 then integration idx0; TASK-WI-0001-004 unit idx0-4 then regression idx0; TASK-WI-0001-005 integration idx0 then e2e idx0. Do NOT create any verification_evidence wrapper files or probes; do NOT reference old 1.0.22 receipts as current assets. Use actual verifiable times for created_at (the run times of the new receipts, ~2026-11-07T08:59–09:15Z per handoff recorded_at); never fabricate future times.
2. Write via sf_artifact_write(work_item_id="WI-0001", file_type="verification_report", template="verification_report", content=<structured Verification JSON string>) with summary result passed, all 22 command results, and a "semantic_closure" field containing the complete typed semantic closure manifest (schema_version "1.0", work_item_id "WI-0001", workflow_type "feature_spec"). The closure must carry the full real consumption chain: outcomes, requirements (REQ-CORE-001..006, MUST/SHOULD per spec), design_decisions (DD-CORE-001..006), tasks (TASK-WI-0001-001..005), evidence (22 items: id, status "passed", level and evidence_type truthfully — static grep/test-f existence assertions are L1 static (command_output/verification), the `node --test` integration runs are behavioral test_output (L3/L4) consuming the real project load environment + greet implementation + test suite (note this for EV at TASK-003 integration idx0 and TASK-005 integration idx0, i.e. EV-0010 and EV-0021), the e2e dynamic import (EV-0022) is behavioral and byte-identical in outcome to the README examples ("Hello, Ada!" / "Hello, world!") — state the support relations explicitly via supports/outcome_refs/requirement_refs/task_refs; do NOT inflate static L1 assertions into behavioral evidence), and project_integration (status "merged", refs to PSV-0002/merge evidence). Evidence supports/related refs must be consistent between the report's semantic_closure and the manifest entries.
3. Call sf_handoff(action="write") schema 1.0, agent="sf-verifier", stage="verification-aggregate-formal-v1.0.23", with outputs_written (the two artifact paths), findings, unknowns, escalation_signals (empty if none), full Required Output registration.
4. Return to the orchestrator: confirmation of both writes, the evidence entry count, and the COMPLETE typed semantic_closure object verbatim (the orchestrator must pass it unmodified to sf_semantic_closure_run).

If any sf_artifact_write validation fails, report the exact error verbatim; do not hand-edit files or retry with altered ownership. Do not run any new verification attempts. Do not transition state.
